body:
🟡🏛️ **Consider · adr: ADR 0028 still names niway-dev/wachi-reviewer pinned to v1.2.0**

This line now calls `niway-dev/wachiman` at `v1.2.1`. ADR 0028 still says otherwise. Its Status row (`architecture/decisions/0028-advisory-claude-review-on-pull-requests.mdx:12`) reads "now consumed through the reusable workflow `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer`". Its latest amendment (line 93, "the engine is now niway-dev/wachi-reviewer, pinned to v1.2.0") names the old repository and tag. The previous rename (`agent-review` → `wachi-reviewer`) got its own dated amendment in that ADR. ADRs here are append-only, so this rename and tag bump could follow the same pattern: add an amendment such as "the engine is now niway-dev/wachiman, pinned to v1.2.1" that cites wachiman's ADR 0009, and update the Status line to link to it. Without that, the ADR points readers to a repository that `uses:` can no longer resolve.

<!-- wachi:finding -->
